passages.text: Therefore, since Christ suffered in His body, arm yourselves with the same resolve, because anyone who has suffered in his body is done with sin.
passages.sermon:
Christ suffered in His body.
Christ is righteous.
Christ suffered for others.
You must prepare your mind with the same resolve as Christ.
You must be ready to suffer for what is right.
Anyone who suffers in his body for doing right has finished with sin.
He no longer lives for sin.
passages.original: Χριστοῦ οὖν παθόντος σαρκὶ καὶ ὑμεῖς τὴν αὐτὴν ἔννοιαν ὁπλίσασθε ὅτι ὁ παθὼν σαρκὶ πέπαυται ἁμαρτίας

passages.text: Consequently, he does not live out his remaining time on earth for human passions, but for the will of God.
passages.sermon:
A Christian no longer lives for human desires.
He spends his remaining time on earth for the will of God.
He does not follow sinful passions.
He chooses to obey God’s will.
passages.original: εἰς τὸ μηκέτι ἀνθρώπων ἐπιθυμίαις ἀλλὰ θελήματι Θεοῦ τὸν ἐπίλοιπον ἐν σαρκὶ βιῶσαι χρόνον

passages.text: For you have spent enough time in the past carrying out the same desires as the Gentiles: living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing, and detestable idolatry.
passages.sermon:
You are Christians.
You once lived like the Gentiles.
You followed their desires.
You spent enough time doing these things in the past.
You lived in debauchery.
You lived in lust.
You lived in drunkenness.
You joined in orgies.
You joined in carousing.
You practiced detestable idolatry.
passages.original: ἀρκετὸς γὰρ ὁ παρεληλυθὼς χρόνος τὸ βούλημα τῶν ἐθνῶν κατειργάσθαι πεπορευμένους ἐν ἀσελγείαις ἐπιθυμίαις οἰνοφλυγίαις κώμοις πότοις καὶ ἀθεμίτοις εἰδωλολατρίαις

passages.text: Because of this, they consider it strange of you not to plunge with them into the same flood of reckless indiscretion, and they heap abuse on you.
passages.sermon:
Unbelievers notice your new way of life.
They see that you do not join them in reckless living.
They think it is strange that you do not act as they do.
They speak against you because of this.
passages.original: Ἐν ᾧ ξενίζονται μὴ συντρεχόντων ὑμῶν εἰς τὴν αὐτὴν τῆς ἀσωτίας ἀνάχυσιν βλασφημοῦντες

passages.text: But they will have to give an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
passages.sermon: God is ready to judge all people.\r\nGod will judge both the living and the dead.\r\nThey must give an account to God.
passages.original: οἳ ἀποδώσουσιν λόγον τῷ ἑτοίμως ἔχοντι κρῖναι ζῶντας καὶ νεκρούς

passages.text: That is why the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged as men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
passages.sermon:
God sent the gospel to people who are now dead.
God wanted these people to hear the good news.
God allowed them to be judged as humans in their bodies.
God also wanted them to live by His Spirit.
God gives life according to His Spirit.
passages.original: εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ καὶ νεκροῖς εὐηγγελίσθη ἵνα κριθῶσι μὲν κατὰ ἀνθρώπους σαρκί ζῶσι δὲ κατὰ Θεὸν πνεύματι

passages.text: The end of all things is near. Therefore be clear-minded and sober, so that you can pray.
passages.sermon:
God will soon bring all things to an end.
The end is near.
Be clear-minded.
Be sober.
Pray.
passages.original: Πάντων δὲ τὸ τέλος ἤγγικεν σωφρονήσατε οὖν καὶ νήψατε εἰς προσευχάς

passages.text: Above all, love one another deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.
passages.sermon:
Peter wrote this letter to Christians.
He told them what is most important.
He said, “Above all, love one another deeply.”
Love is strong and sincere.
Love covers many sins.
Love forgives and hides faults.
Love brings healing among people.
passages.original: πρὸ πάντων τὴν εἰς ἑαυτοὺς ἀγάπην ἐκτενῆ ἔχοντες ὅτι ἀγάπη καλύπτει πλῆθος ἁμαρτιῶν

passages.text: Show hospitality to one another without complaining.
passages.sermon: Show hospitality to one another.\r\nDo not complain when you do this.

passages.text: As good stewards of the manifold grace of God, each of you should use whatever gift he has received to serve one another.
passages.sermon:
God gives many different kinds of grace.
God gives each believer a special gift.
Each person should use the gift he has received.
Each person should serve others with his gift.
Each person should act as a good steward of God's grace.
passages.original: ἕκαστος καθὼς ἔλαβεν χάρισμα εἰς ἑαυτοὺς αὐτὸ διακονοῦντες ὡς καλοὶ οἰκονόμοι ποικίλης χάριτος Θεοῦ

passages.text: If anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of God. If anyone serves, he should serve with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
passages.sermon:
If anyone speaks, he must speak the words of God.
If anyone serves, he must serve with the strength that God gives.
God must be glorified in everything through Jesus Christ.
Jesus Christ receives all glory and power forever and ever.
Amen.
passages.original: εἴ τις λαλεῖ ὡς λόγια Θεοῦ εἴ τις διακονεῖ ὡς ἐξ ἰσχύος ἧς χορηγεῖ ὁ Θεός ἵνα ἐν πᾶσιν δοξάζηται ὁ Θεὸς διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ᾧ ἐστιν ἡ δόξα καὶ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν

passages.text: Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trial that has come upon you, as though something strange were happening to you.
passages.sermon:
Beloved, I speak to you who follow Christ.
Do not be surprised when a fiery trial comes upon you.
This trial tests you.
Do not think this trial is something strange.
This trial is not unusual for you.
passages.original: Ἀγαπητοί μὴ ξενίζεσθε τῇ ἐν ὑμῖν πυρώσει πρὸς πειρασμὸν ὑμῖν γινομένῃ ὡς ξένου ὑμῖν συμβαίνοντος

passages.text: But rejoice that you share in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed at the revelation of His glory.
passages.sermon:
You share in the sufferings of Christ.
Rejoice because of this.
When God reveals Christ’s glory, you will be overjoyed.
You will be very glad at that time.
passages.original: ἀλλὰ καθὸ κοινωνεῖτε τοῖς τοῦ Χριστοῦ παθήμασιν χαίρετε ἵνα καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀποκαλύψει τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ χαρῆτε ἀγαλλιώμενοι

passages.text: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
passages.sermon: If people insult you because you follow Christ, you are blessed.\r\nThe Spirit of glory rests on you.\r\nThe Spirit of God rests on you.
passages.original: Εἰ ὀνειδίζεσθε ἐν ὀνόματι Χριστοῦ μακάριοι ὅτι τὸ τῆς δόξης καὶ τὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ Πνεῦμα ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς ἀναπαύεται

passages.text: Indeed, none of you should suffer as a murderer or thief or wrongdoer, or even as a meddler.
passages.sermon:
You are followers of Christ.
You must not suffer for doing evil.
Do not suffer as a murderer.
Do not suffer as a thief.
Do not suffer as a wrongdoer.
Do not suffer as a meddler.
passages.original: μὴ γάρ τις ὑμῶν πασχέτω ὡς φονεὺς ἢ κλέπτης ἢ κακοποιὸς ἢ ὡς ἀλλοτριεπίσκοπος

passages.text: But if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but glorify God that you bear that name.
passages.sermon: A Christian is a follower of Jesus Christ.\r\nIf you suffer because you are a Christian, do not feel shame.\r\nGlorify God because you carry the name of Christ.
passages.original: εἰ δὲ ὡς Χριστιανός μὴ αἰσχυνέσθω δοξαζέτω δὲ τὸν Θεὸν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τούτῳ

passages.text: For it is time for judgment to begin with the family of God; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who disobey the gospel of God?
passages.sermon:
God’s family is the church.
God will begin judgment with His own people.
Now is the time for this judgment to start.
God’s judgment starts with us, the believers.
Some people disobey the gospel of God.
If judgment begins with us, their outcome will be even more serious.
Those who reject God’s gospel will face a worse result.
passages.original: ὅτι ὁ καιρὸς τοῦ ἄρξασθαι τὸ κρίμα ἀπὸ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰ δὲ πρῶτον ἀφ’ ἡμῶν τί τὸ τέλος τῶν ἀπειθούντων τῷ τοῦ Θεοῦ εὐαγγελίῳ

passages.text: And, “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?”
passages.sermon:
God judges all people.
God saves the righteous with difficulty.
The righteous are those who obey God.
It is hard for the righteous to be saved.
The ungodly do not honor God.
Sinners disobey God.
The ungodly and sinners face a worse outcome.
If the righteous are saved with difficulty, the ungodly and sinners will not escape judgment.
passages.original: καὶ Εἰ ὁ δίκαιος μόλις σώζεται ὁ ἀσεβὴς καὶ ἁμαρτωλὸς ποῦ φανεῖται

passages.text: So then, those who suffer according to God’s will should entrust their souls to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.
passages.sermon:
God is faithful.
God is the Creator.
Some people suffer.
They suffer because it is God’s will.
These people should trust God with their souls.
They should keep doing good.
passages.original: Ὥστε καὶ οἱ πάσχοντες κατὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ πιστῷ Κτίστῃ παρατιθέσθωσαν τὰς ψυχὰς αὐτῶν ἐν ἀγαθοποιΐᾳ
